_readme: FIAT GEAR - the new items, in one go: the builds pass's uniques, the five sets' pieces, the melee weapons, the small melee and the melee parts (grips and heads), the grenades, the scrap icon and the new ammo grades - every job from uniques, sets, melee, melee_small, melee_parts, grenades, misc, ammo whose art/items/<slug>.png was not on disk when this was generated. 8 jobs.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_items_new_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). Rides art/reference/items/ref_01..04.png as style like the rest of the pool. A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_item_manifests.py on the machine that holds the art, so the 'exists' test sees the real folder; the per-group manifests are the same jobs grouped.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single black chest rig with six pouches, standing upright as if hung on a hook, seen from the front, filling the frame: every pouch dark with petrol stains, a lighter on a cord, scorch marks up one side, a rag tucked in a pouch. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
